laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_1_density_and_continuity: Because K |-> C_tau(K) = sum_rho m_rho a_rho tau^{-K(rho - 1/2)} is continuous on R (by uniform normal convergence on compact K-intervals from Stirling decay |a_rho| << |gamma|^{15/2} exp(-pi|gamma|/2)) and Qbar intersect R is dense in R, |C_tau(K)| <= C_tau(0) on Qbar intersect R implies |C_tau(t)| <= C_tau(0) for all t in R.
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_2_normal_convergence_of_partial_fra: For Re(w) > L/2, int_0^infty e^{-wt} tau^{t(rho - 1/2)} dt = 1 / (w - L(rho - 1/2)). Since sum_rho m_rho |a_rho| < infty, the partial-fraction series R_tau(w) := sum_rho m_rho a_rho / (w - L(rho - 1/2)) converges normally on every compact subset of C \ {L(rho - 1/2)} and coincides with the Laplace transform L[C_tau(-t)](w) = int_0^infty e^{-wt} C_tau(-t) dt on Re(w) > L/2.
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_3_right_half_plane_holomorphy_from_: Under |C_tau(-t)| <= C_tau(0) for all t >= 0, the Laplace integral L[C_tau(-t)](w) converges absolutely and defines a holomorphic function on the entire open right half-plane Re(w) > 0, with |L[C_tau(-t)](w)| <= C_tau(0) / Re(w).
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_4_nonvanishing_simple_pole_residue: If zeta(s) had a zero rho_0 = 1/2 + delta_0 + i*gamma_0 with 0 < delta_0 < 1/2, then w_0 := L(rho_0 - 1/2) = L*delta_0 + i*L*gamma_0 lies in Re(w) = L*delta_0 > 0. Because the map rho |-> w_rho = L(rho - 1/2) is injective on C, no other distinct zero rho != rho_0 shares the pole point w_0; the residue of R_tau(w) at w = w_0 is m_{rho_0} a_{rho_0} = m_{rho_0} F_tau(rho_0) conj(F_tau(1 - conj(rho_0))) != 0 (since m_{rho_0} >= 1 and F_tau(s) != 0 on 0 < Re(s) < 1), contradicting holomorphy on Re(w) > 0.
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_5_functional_equation_reflection: If rho_0 = 1/2 + delta_0 + i*gamma_0 had -1/2 < delta_0 < 0, the functional equation xi(1 - s) = xi(s) supplies the reflected zero rho_0' = 1 - conj(rho_0) = 1/2 - delta_0 + i*gamma_0 with Re(rho_0' - 1/2) = -delta_0 > 0, reducing to Step 4.
laplace_resolvent_proof_steps.step_6_converse_under_rh: Under RH, every nontrivial zero has rho = 1/2 + i*gamma_rho, so 1 - conj(rho) = rho, a_rho = |F_tau(1/2 + i*gamma_rho)|^2 > 0, and C_tau(0) = sum_rho m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 > 0. For every real K, |C_tau(K)| = |sum_rho m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 tau^{-i K gamma_rho L}| <= sum_rho m_rho |F_tau(rho)|^2 = C_tau(0).

local_concavity_and_derivatives.taylor_concavity_inequality: Zero-free 6th-order Taylor enclosure (using sup_{|K| <= 0.08} |C_tau^(6)(K)| <= M_6^arith = 27971954.7866) certifies the exact rational interval 0 < |K| <= 1/20 = 0.05 with strict margin (and polynomial root |K| <= 0.051486 for C_tau(K) > 0 and |C_tau(K)| < C_tau(0)); unconditional spectral-tail 4th-order Taylor enclosure certifies the exact rational interval 0 < |K| <= 17/250 = 0.068 with strict margin (polynomial root |K| <= 0.068465 for two-sided |C_tau(K)| < C_tau(0), and C_tau(K) < C_tau(0) on 0 < |K| <= 0.133277).

finite_toeplitz_gram_matrices.comparison_2x2_vs_NxN: Positive-definiteness of the N x N Toeplitz Gram matrices is certified via outward-rounded leading principal minor determinants (`flint.arb_mat.det()`, Sylvester's criterion) on the full Arb enclosures. Moreover, even a finite uniform bound |C_tau(K)| <= M < infty suffices to make the Laplace transform holomorphic on Re(w) > 0 and imply RH.

section_8_tau_role_scaling_controls.scaling_identity: C_{a,b}(K) = sqrt(a_0 / a) * C_{a_0,tau}(K * log(b) / log(tau)), where a_0 = tau/2 = pi
section_8_tau_role_scaling_controls.physical_space_mechanism: Because psi_a(x) = x^{1/2} P_2(a x^2) exp(-a x^2) = (a_0/a)^{1/4} psi_tau(sqrt(a/a_0) x), multiplicative convolution with Haar measure dy/y is scale-invariant in y and factors out ((a_0/a)^{1/4})^2 = sqrt(a_0/a), while b^K x = tau^{(K log b / log tau)} x.
section_8_tau_role_scaling_controls.spectral_space_mechanism: In Mellin space, F_a(s) = (a_0 / a)^{s/2} F_tau(s), so on every zero pair (rho, 1 - conj(rho)) where rho + (1 - rho) = 1, the product F_a(rho) conj(F_a(1 - conj(rho))) = (a_0/a)^{1/2} a_rho scales by sqrt(a_0/a) independently of rho.
section_8_tau_role_scaling_controls.tau_role_implication: Replacing b = tau by any b > 1 merely reparametrizes the real grade line K |-> K log(b)/log(tau), and replacing a = pi by a > 0 scales C_{a,b} by sqrt(pi/a). Therefore, any arithmetic proof of |C_tau(K)| <= C_tau(0) must either establish the inequality for all real shifts kappa = K log(tau) in R or exploit the specific self-dual Poisson/modular coupling between the archimedean factor pi^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2) and the integer lattice Z at a = pi = tau/2.

attempt_2_local_concavity_and_archimedea.conclusion: At K = 0, BOTH the completed archimedean sector (-0.257595 < 0, arising from -167.403799 archimedean integral curvature + 167.146204 local constant curvature) AND the prime-power sector (-0.384145 < 0) are strictly concave, reinforcing each other to give C_tau''(0) = -0.641740 < 0. The 100% zero-free arithmetic 6th-order Taylor enclosure (using sup_{|K| <= 0.08} |C_tau^{(6)}(K)| <= M_6^{arith} = 433.5413) certifies the exact rational interval 0 < |K| <= 1/20 = 0.05 with strict margin (lower-bound polynomial root 0.051486), while the unconditional spectral-tail 4th-order Taylor enclosure certifies the exact rational interval 0 < |K| <= 17/250 = 0.068 with strict margin (lower-bound polynomial root 0.068465, upper concavity root 0.133277).

attempt_A_multiscale_euler_operator_and_.primitive_transfer_analysis: Integrating by parts against E_1(x) = int_1^x E(t) dt = psi_1(x) - x^2/2 + 1/2 gives I(X) = (1/2) h_1(1/X) + int_1^infty E_1(x) x^(-5/2) h_1(x/X) dx where h_1(alpha) = (3/2) tilde{h}_0(alpha) - D_alpha tilde{h}_0(alpha). At the critical-line exponent s = 1/2 (weights Lambda(n)/sqrt(n)), transferring derivatives suppresses the high-frequency tail x >> X by (X/x)^k, but on the resonant scale band x in [X/4, 4X] the scale derivative d/dx [tilde{h}_0(x/X)] = x^(-1) (D_alpha tilde{h}_0)(x/X) has scale factor x^(-1) ~ X^(-1), which exactly balances the extra power of x in E_1(x).

attempt_3_large_grade_wavelet_decomposit.why_large_K_is_not_trivially_suppressed: While the forward prime sum P_fwd(K) and archimedean term W_arch(h_K) decay exponentially in K > 0 (and are uniformly bounded for all K >= 0 by 0.633039 and 5.464660 respectively), the reflected prime sum P_refl(K) = -W(tau^K) = -sum_{n>=2} (Lambda(n)/sqrt(n)) h_0(n/tau^K) sweeps its peak alpha = n/tau^K = 1 across all primes n ~ tau^K as K -> +infty. Because ANY finite uniform bound |C_tau(K)| <= M < infty suffices for right-half-plane Laplace holomorphy, the problem reduces to uniform boundedness of W(X) for X >= 1.
